feeding_claim.verbatim: We raise natural, grass-fed and grass-finished beef, sheep, and goat, along with pasture-raised pork.

notes: Meat is sold in-store only at two Dothan locations (677 Pilgrim Road and 8238 US-84 West), weekdays 9 to 5 and Saturday 9 to 2. Beef sold as half or whole cows and prepackaged cuts; pork as half or whole hogs. The online shop sells only tallow skincare. Site says animals are grain-free from conception to consumption. No farmers market, delivery or shipping stated.
resold_note: Store also sells chicken, eggs, quail and quail eggs; the site does not say they are raised on the farm.
